message.subject: Free Webinar: Stop working for others. Start your AI Consulting Business
message.html:
Hey Jishnu,

The people who are quietly building six-figure consulting businesses right now aren't AI researchers. They're domain experts - in finance, operations, healthcare, marketing, law, HR - who learned how to pair what they already know with AI tools.

As an expert in your field, you can do the same.

On Wednesday, May 27 at 3:00 PM Eastern, Stack is hosting a free live panel with Stack Certified AI Consultants:

What we'll cover:
→ How to identify the highest-value AI use cases in your specific domain
→ How to position yourself as an AI consultant regardless of your background
→ How to land your first clients
→ The exact path from employee or freelancer to independent AI consultant

This is a live conversation with people doing this work — not a pitch deck.

👉 Reserve your free spot

Spots are limited. This is a live session — not a recorded course.

🎁 One live attendee will be chosen to win a free 6-month membership to Stack, a $1500 value!

See you on May 27 at 3 PM ET.

- The Stack Team

Unsubscribe
